name: Pose bridge (3D OpenPose editor)
about: The collaborative pose bridge beside a 3D OpenPose editor (its own small API, port 8080 by default): poses a person shapes in the editor and an AI drafts, kept as files. Each file is an asset that does "pose", and "latest" names whichever changed last. pose_read gives one ("pose": its file name, "latest", or "active" for the last record written); pose_add keeps an editor scene as a new file ("pose": the name wanted, "scene": the scene; a taken name gets -2, -3); pose_write writes a record and makes it the active one. It has no key of its own: keep it on the home network.
